title: Maximal matroids and counterexamples
summary: Jackson and Tanigawa conjectured that the rigidity matroid $\mathcal{R}^d_n$ and the hyperconnectivity matroid $\mathcal{H}^d_n$ are the unique maximal matroids in the posets of $\{K_{d+2}, K_{d+2,d+2}\}$-matroids and $\{K_{d+2},K_{d+1,d+1}\}$-matroids, respectively. We disprove these conjectures by showing the existence of maximal matroids that are distinct from the proposed candidates.
